## The problem

What you cannot do today, in one paragraph, with the command or workflow it blocks.

## Proposal

What the change looks like from the user's side (command, flag, config key, hook clause).
If there is more than one way, list them with a line on the cost of each.

## Out of scope

What this request is not about, so the discussion stays on one thing.
